thread:
nico: heads-up: planning to lift runtime pin for marigold (runtime 1.9.8 -> 2.0.0) in the 03:00-04:00 UTC change window. contains upstream rate-limit propagation fix + improved cache invalidation. need ops, release note, and product signoff. blockers?
harper: please check safelist rules — a small cohort of partners are whitelisted on the old behavior and could get 429s if we change the header semantics.
nico: good call. adding gating: safelist/consistency==ok. deploybot: include partner cohort routing and a shadow run ahead of canary.
deploybot: scheduled: preflight shadow run at 02:30 for 20m, canary plan 5% -> 25% -> 100% with manual hold before final. automatic rollback triggers: 5xx_rate>1% OR 429_rate>2x baseline for 5m.
pm-bot: draft release blurb requested: one-line note + migration snippet for client teams. Assigning to @nico.
zev: telemetry note: ap-southeast has a history of strict upstream rate-limiters; recommend we exclude that region from first canary.
nico: excluding ap-southeast from canary cohort. Gate updated. Also adding a post-deploy mapping rule for old->new headers to reduce client-side breakage.
deploybot: preflight shadow started 02:31 UTC. Running partner-cohort tests and mapping check.
deploybot: preflight PASS at 02:50 UTC. safelist/consistency==ok. Gates cleared.
deploybot: Canary started 03:05 UTC -> 5% marigold traffic. Initial metrics: latency improved 5%, errors flat. Advancing to 25% at 03:12.
zev: seeing a sudden spike in 429s from upstream auth gateway at 03:16 in eu-west coincident with the 25% bump. 429_rate ~2.8x baseline.
harper: that's on the guarded partner cohort? could still affect partners since header mapping isn't fully applied on the gateway.
nico: HOLD. deploybot, rollback to pinned runtime now.
deploybot: Executing rollback -> applying runtime pin=1.9.8. Command: `deploybot rollback --target runtime=1.9.8 --reason "upstream 429 spike eu-west"`
deploybot: Rollback complete at 03:20 UTC. Runtime pinned back to 1.9.8. Notifying oncall and creating ticket.
infra: created ticket #1450: upstream gateway rejects new header ordering -> rate-limit spikes. Initial hypothesis: gateway header parser treats new header sequence as suspicious and triggers throttling.
zev: attaching traces and sample request IDs. Seems reproducible when mapping is absent upstream.
nico: action items: (1) coordinate with gateway team to land header mapping fallback, (2) add an automated gateway-check in preflight next try, (3) exclude partners until mapping confirmed. Will update release notes: "unpin attempt aborted -> rollback due to upstream 429s; retry when gateway mapping is validated."
pm-bot: release note updated in #release-notes with the snippet and rollback note.
harper: schedule next attempt only after gateway mapping PR merged + 30m shadow verification. Tagging @zev for verification.
nico: agreed. thank you all. closing this thread; follow-ups in #release-notes and ticket #1450. :thumbsup:
